messages.author: 3f0d478b4a129e90
messages.subject: Compiling recursive functions in rstan
parts:
I'm trying to get the following model in "matching_rasch_ideal.stan" working in rstan. When I compile the model using

model <- stan_model(stanc_ret = stanc_builder("stan/matching_rasch_ideal.stan"))

I obtain the output in "matching_rasch_ideal_compile_log.txt", indicating that the "matching_log" function is defined multiple times. "matching_log" is a recursive function, so I've forward declared it in "functions_ideal.stan".  Though I can implement it w/o recursion, I'd like to keep "matching_log" as is, since it simplifies my code a little. Am I implementing recursive functions incorrectly, calling Stan's model builder incorrect or is the feature simply not implement?

Thanks!
